handoff: Audit fixed 7 errors. Dead worlds are locked until balance dead_unlock_cycle (15): no route, send, order or panel use before; panel shows PLANET_DEAD_LOCKED; DEAD_UNLOCK notice posts at cycle 15. Null Core: Build at the trading post (plate + nullglass + credits, one per run), fit to one ship in the ships window; trips cost null_core_trip_mult, immune to pirate cut. Tests: 952 pass, 0 fail (use a private TMPDIR: the shared scratch dir races with other runs and gave flaky 'win' failures).

audit_fixed: Gate bypass: a send from a dead world to Space Storage skipped M1/M2 (check_station). Now gated.
Gate bypass: a Buy order at a dead world mined it without M1/M2. Now check_local refuses buy orders without the skill.
Load order: learned skills loaded after routes and orders, so a skill-gated order would be dropped on load. Skills now load first.
Debris event (EV17) could pick a dead world at random; now only unlocked planets. Event cluster spawn skips locked dead worlds too.
EV35 (pair C) fired only when a further route started from a dead world, so it could never fire. It now fires at the start of a cycle once EV29 and EV32 have fired.
Scheduled event replaced a cycle's random slot but left the B4 forecast naming a different event; forecast is cleared.
Choice fee for [cost: key] always read dead_shore_cost; now uses the parsed effect amount.

details.gate_rules: Locked dead worlds: refused for new routes from/to, sends to storage, any local order; saved routes and orders at a locked world are dropped on load. Skills can be learned before 15. Tutorial, events, sim hooks and skill-point awards cannot reach a dead world before 15 (all go through these checks or the debris pick).
